page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with running head at top right above the text; printed page number at top left. Centred display arithmetic (diagrams and calculations) interspersed with running text. No margin notes. Blank foot below the last calculation, with a small marginal-style calculation fragment at lower right.

main_text.head: Aliud exemplum.
main_text.p: Venditur Cantharus Cerevisiæ 4 numulis. Quæritur quot numulis, 16 Canthari veneant? Colloco sic:
Nunc 64 numulos duco in solidos per 12, sic:
Sedecim igitur Canthari veneunt 5 solidis, & 4 numulis.
main_text.head: Probatio.

page.notes: Printed text is set in italic for "Aliud exemplum." and "Probatio." heads. The lower-right fragment "64 4 (4" is a partial calculation printed at the margin; read with doubt. Some numerals in the arithmetic diagrams are ambiguous at this scan resolution and are given as best read. The "12," in "per 12, sic:" and the "Cerevisiæ" word are as best read. The left edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page edge, which is not transcribed.
